summary: Request: temporary admin toggle to disable new circuit breaker logic per region for emergency mitigation
environment: prod (all regions; toggle must be scoped per region)
description:
## Request / Background
During Hosted overload protection rollout (circuit breakers + load shedding), oncall needs an emergency mitigation lever to quickly disable the *new breaker evaluation path* in a single region without requiring a full rollback or redeploy.

This is intended as a temporary, last-resort control to reduce blast radius if breaker logic misbehaves (e.g., flapping, false opens, or unexpected customer-facing 429/503 increase).

Related context:
- Recent canary planning has breakers enabled behind flags, but we do not currently have a fast “kill switch” that can be executed by oncall with proper audit/logging.
- This request is coming from support ops/oncall readiness work for the Reliability Program.

## Requirements
1) Provide an admin-accessible toggle to disable circuit breaker enforcement in a single region (e.g., us-east) for Hosted.
   - Scope: per region; optionally per model later, but region-level is required for now.
   - Effect: routing should behave as if breaker is CLOSED/ignored (i.e., do not shed due to breaker-open decisions); existing quotas/rate limits still apply.

2) Toggle must be:
   - Fast to flip (<= 2 minutes for propagation)
   - Audited (who, when, what region, previous value)
   - Safe by default (requires explicit action to enable; includes TTL/auto-expire if feasible)

3) Access control
   - SRE oncall and designated release leads can execute.
   - Prefer existing admin surface used for incident mitigations.

4) Observability
   - Emit an event/metric when override is active (region label)
   - Add log annotation on routing decisions that are bypassing breakers due to override

## Acceptance Criteria
- Oncall can disable breaker enforcement in a specific region and confirm via metric/log within 2 minutes.
- Toggle change is recorded in audit logs.
- Runbook entry exists (what it does / when to use / risks).

## Notes / Risks
- Disabling breakers in a region can increase tail latency and risk cascades if the region is truly overloaded; this is meant for cases where breaker logic itself is the source of customer impact.
- Should include a default TTL (suggest 60 minutes) to prevent leaving the system in a weakened state.

## Requested by
Oncall readiness / incident mitigation (SRE) for Hosted API overload protection rollout.

## Links
- Slack: #eng-oncall discussion re: emergency toggle request
- Program: Hosted circuit breakers + load shedding initiative
comments: 2025-11-10 09:18 (Owen Phillips): Raising this as internal support because we don’t have a fast rollback lever if the breaker path causes false opens during canary. Need something SRE can flip during an incident without waiting on deploys.

2025-11-10 10:02 (Rafael Mendes): +1. We should treat this like a kill switch. Region-scoped is the minimum; TTL/auto-expire would be great. Also needs to be visible on the overload dashboard so we don’t misinterpret reduced shedding as improvement.

2025-11-10 11:11 (Benji Okafor): Acknowledged. Proposal: add an override config in the control-plane config store (same mechanism as other emergency knobs). Routing service reads override every 30s; gateway unaffected. Will add metric `routing_breaker_override_active{region}` and include override marker in routing logs.

2025-11-11 14:27 (Christine Wong): Please ensure the behavior is explicit: bypass breaker-open decisions, but keep other shed points (runtime queue bound / memory pressure) intact. This should not disable runtime-level protection, only the routing breaker gate.

2025-11-12 09:06 (Benji Okafor): Implemented override in routing config path: `breaker_enforcement_disabled=true` with scope `region=<name>`. Added TTL support (default 60m) and audit log entries. Testing in staging shows propagation ~45s. Sharing PR link in related PRs.

2025-11-13 16:40 (Owen Phillips): Confirmed with SRE: staging validation passed. Please add a short runbook section including when to use + how to revert + expected metrics shift (shed rate drop, breaker state still tracked but not enforced).
2025-11-14 10:15 (Benji Okafor): Runbook snippet added and permissions documented (SRE oncall, release coord). Marking resolved.
resolution: Added a region-scoped admin override to bypass routing-level circuit breaker enforcement with audit logging and TTL (default 60m). Exposed `routing_breaker_override_active{region}` metric and log annotations when bypass is in effect. Documented usage and risks in Hosted overload mitigation runbook.
